followups.problem: The new render test gives renderProjectCockpit a hand-built project with readyIds: ['R-1']. No test runs buildProjectCockpit on a board whose project has card.next.items and checks that readyIds comes out as those ids. fakeBoard (line 158) has no card, so every buildProjectCockpit test only covers readyIds === null. That null path does show that a payload without readyIds still uses readyTickets as before.
followups.exploit_or_failure: The tests would still pass if the mapping at tools/command-center-snapshot.mjs:425-428 broke, for example by reading card.next.ready, dropping the String() coercion, or returning [] instead of null. The live Cockpit would then go back to the stripped-ledger ready set, or show an empty ready column.
followups.fix: Add a test with fakeBoard({ card: { next: { items: [{ id: 'R-1' }] } }, ledger: { tickets: [R-1 ready, T-1 todo] } }). Assert that buildProjectCockpit(...).readyIds deepEquals ['R-1'], then render it and assert that T-1 is not in #tickets-left. Add a second case without card.next and assert readyIds === null.

followups.problem: readyIds is taken from card.next.items. That only matches counts.ready if board-data puts the whole readyTickets(fullLedger) list in next.items. If it puts in a short preview (top N), readyIds is a subset. I could not read tools/board-data.mjs to check.
followups.exploit_or_failure: If next.items is capped at N and fewer than counts.ready tickets are ready, the left column lists only N ready rows. The other ready tickets fall into 'to do' rows, and the '+N more' overflow undercounts ready. Meanwhile NEXT UP shows '1 / 15' because it reads headline.ready (cc-cockpit-mount.js:571). Neither number is wrong, but the screen disagrees with itself again.
followups.fix: Confirm that board-data's card.next.items is the full readyTickets(fullLedger) list and not sliced. If it is sliced, send a separate full readyIds array from board-data, or add an assert/test that card.next.items.length === counts.ready.

followups.problem: Followup (b) is still open. The cross-page parity test is stub against stub, and no test builds counts with board-data projectOverview/projectDetail from a real fixture ledger.
followups.exploit_or_failure: A board-data regression would pass every test: counts taken from a scoped or filtered ledger, counts dropped from projectDetail, or next.items/next.ready drifting from counts.ready.
followups.fix: Add a board-data integration test. Use a fixture ledger with deps, a human ticket, and cancelled and superseded rows. Assert counts equals ticketCountsOf(fullLedger), card.next.ready === counts.ready, and card.next.items ids equal the dependency-aware ready set.

followups.problem: Followup (f) is still open. deriveHiveView lists snap.projects.slice(0, 10) but uses board-wide snap.totals across every card.
followups.exploit_or_failure: With 11 or more projects, the panel totals include projects that are not in the per-project list, and nothing on screen says so.
followups.fix: Label the totals as board-wide ('across N projects'), or sum only the visible cards when the list is truncated. Add an 11-project test.

followups.problem: The need-you value in the no-counts fallback now comes from card.blocked.needYou (the inbox). Its tooltip still says 'Human tickets still open plus tickets waiting in review.'
followups.exploit_or_failure: Hovering need-you on a payload without counts describes a status-based count that is no longer computed, so the tooltip misleads the owner about where the number comes from.
followups.fix: Use the same tip as the counts branch (line 104): 'Owner inbox items waiting on you for this project.'

followups.problem: readyIds can now be [] while todo rows exist, and in that case the left column shows renderReadyEmptyState. emptyReadyExplanation counts dependency blocks from t.dependsOn, but the stripped commandCenterLedger drops that field.
followups.exploit_or_failure: A project whose todos are all waiting on dependencies shows 'No ready tickets — none are runnable yet' (or '… N still running') and never 'N blocked on dependencies'. The message isn't false, but it no longer explains why nothing is ready. This is cosmetic, not a count mismatch.
followups.fix: Have the server send a dependency-blocked count (e.g. counts.todo minus ready, or card.blocked.onDeps) and use it in the empty explanation when the ledger has no dependsOn.

summary: The blocker is fixed. buildProjectCockpit now emits readyIds from card.next.items, or null when card.next.items is absent (command-center-snapshot.mjs:425-428). projectReadyFn (cc-cockpit-mount.js:78-85) turns readyIds into a readyFn, and paint passes that one function to cockpitLedgerRows (line 625) and renderReadyEmptyState (line 650). Every readiness consumer in the Cockpit now reads it: the ready rows and left column, the todo/open split (cockpit-lists.js:238), the '+N more' overflow detail (lines 257-262), columns.counts.ready, the lead/activeId highlighted row (line 642), the NEXT UP card (lines 565-572), and the empty state. When readyIds is absent, projectReadyFn returns readyTickets, so older payloads and the fakeBoard tests behave as before. readyIds is in the paint signature, so a change to it triggers a repaint. Rows are still limited to live, non-running/done/review/blocked tickets, so a stale id can't promote a finished row. The new render test exercises real behaviour. Its stripped ledger has T-1 as a todo with no dependsOn, which the old readyTickets path would have rendered as ready. The test asserts NEXT UP '1 / 1' is R-1, T-1 is absent from the left column, header 9/3/7 comes from counts, and the ready tile is 1. Status of the earlier followups: (a) addressed: counts now differ from the stripped rows (total 9, ready 0, done 4), source is asserted, and the ledger-only fallback is checked to give a different total. (b) remains. (c) addressed: Hive proj-a now has a counts object, so the DOM test goes through the canonical path. (d) addressed for the mount; the gap left is that no test covers the buildProjectCockpit card.next.items→readyIds mapping (new followup). (e) addressed: the no-counts fallback uses card.blocked.needYou or 0 and still prefers project.total/project.done; only its tooltip is stale. (f) remains. No regressions found in the delta. Limits: I could not read tools/board-data.mjs, so I could not confirm that card.next.items is the full dependency-aware ready list rather than a capped preview. readyIds === counts.ready holds only if it is the full list (followup). I ran no tests; the suite numbers (7679 total, 7648 pass, 0 fail, 22 skipped, 9 todo; focused 45/45) are from the evidence file.
